title: Order revenue
brief: Calculate exact transaction revenue at the order grain.
instructions: Return each paid order in UTC 2024. Sum transaction quantity times transaction price. Empty paid orders have zero revenue.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving order revenue.
